Coram: Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Oral Judgment

Aggrieved by the award passed in MVC.No.1347/2021 dated: 04.02.2023 by the Judge, Addl. Court of Small Causes & MACT, Mysore, whereby the tribunal had awarded the compensation of an amount Rs.4,80,000/- and fixed the liability on the owner of the vehicle, both the insurance company as well as the claimant are before this court.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The claimant's appeal is MFA.No.3575/2023 and the Insurance Company's appeal is MFA.No.3660/2023 and the tribunal had fixed the liability on the insurance company.

2. The Tribunal had granted compensation of an amount of Rs.4,80,000/- as per the table given below:

3.

Learned counsel appearing for the insurance company submits that the driver of the offending vehicle was not having a valid driving license, the charge sheet is filed against the driver under Section 3 R/w Section 181 of the Motor Vehicles Act.
It is submitted that charge sheet clearly shows that the driver is not having a valid driving license.
Hence, the principle of pay and recover will apply and the Tribunal had failed to consider the same.

It is submitted that when it comes to the compensation, when the claimant was in hospital for a period of 6 days, the Tribunal had granted an amount of Rs.15,000/- towards hospitalisation which is on the higher side and the on all counts the compensation granted by the tribunal is on higher side.
NC: 2025:KHC:35221 HC-KAR 4.
Learned counsel appearing for the claimant submits that the Tribunal had failed to grant reasonable compensation on all the counts.
It is submitted that the Tribunal had failed to grant the reasonable amount under the head of loss of earning during the laid up period.
Considering the injuries, even for the loss of amenities the amount that is awarded is a meager amount.

When the doctor had opined that the disability is assessed at 35% to the limb, the Tribunal should have taken 12% to the whole body, but Tribunal had taken 10%, hence, on these counts, the compensation needs to be enhanced.
5. Having heard the learned counsels on either sides, perused the material on record.

Coming to the contention of the insurance company with regard to applying the principle of pay and recover,
considering the charge sheet which clearly shows that the driver of the offending vehicle is not having a valid driving license and in the light of the law laid down in the case of National Insurance Co. Ltd., Vs. Swaran Singh & others1, the principle of pay and recovery will apply.

4 and recover the same from the owner of the vehicle

6. Though vakalath is filed on behalf of the owner of the vehicle, there is no representation.

7. Coming to the enhancement, considering one fracture injury sustained, under the head of pain and suffering, the Tribunal has rightly granted an amount of Rs.40,000/- and no interference is called for.
Considering the fact that he was in hospital for 6 days, under the head of attendant and nourishment, this court is reducing the amount from an amount of Rs.15,000/- to Rs.6,000/-.
Towards Medical expenses the Tribunal had rightly granted an amount of Rs.89,000/- and no interference is called for.
When it comes to loss of earning during laid up period this Court is granting for 3 months an amount of Rs.45,000/-.
Towards loss of future income the Tribunal ought to have taken the disability at 12% to the whole body.
As 1/3rd of 35% percent has to be taken, which comes to 11.6 and it is rounded off 12.
Considering the Income at Rs.15,000/- this court is granting an amount of Rs.3,67,200/- (Rs.15,000x 12 X17 x 12/100 = NC: 2025:KHC:35221 HC-KAR Rs.3,67,200/-).
Considering the disability at 12% under the head of loss of amenities, this court is granting an amount of Rs.25,000/-.

8. In the light of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of V.Mekala vs. M.
Malathi and Another2, the claimant is entitled for an amount of Rs.10,000/- towards legal expenses.

ii. The insurance company shall pay the compensation amount to the claimant and recover the same from the owner of the vehicle.
